There's no currency conversion tool. So we cannot call a function. We can answer with approximate conversion using known rates? But we should not provide inaccurate info. We could say "I don't have real-time data." But maybe we can approximate using typical rates. But better to say we can't fetch real-time. We can provide approximate based on recent rates.
